title: recovery and detection under immediate denial, plus timeout recovery (30 cells)

config_audit.not_in: run.started payload, which carries no config

spend.prose: Tier 2 establishes that both mitigation strategies work as designed against accidental evidence denial, at measurable and very different costs. Full restart recovered in 20/20 cells with a verified clean slate -- attempt 2 recorded zero injected faults in every cell -- but discards 37% of the arm's tokens as waste by construction, and under timeout manifestation it adds a near-constant ~195s wall-clock penalty. Always-verify detects the denial reliably rather than indiscriminately: 94% recall on the workers that actually held the denied document against a 4% false-positive rate on clean workers in the same runs (98% precision), at a cost of 39% of total tokens, with all of that signal arriving at the worker-result boundary while the plan boundary flagged 0 of 42 plans. Neither strategy changed the outcome -- all 30 cells graded correct -- reproducing section 5's finding that persistent single-document denial under the immediate manifestation has no measurable effect on answer accuracy.

notes: PROPAGATION IS STRUCTURALLY UNMEASURABLE IN THE FULL-RESTART ARM (20 of 30 cells). research.py:36-37 stamps status=interrupted on every node once runtime.injected_faults is non-empty while full_restart and attempt==1, and runner.py:129-130 sets will_restart and skips grading for attempt 1, so attempt 1 ends at the first completed node after the denial and the Lead never reasons about the missing evidence; attempt 2 then runs clean via _build_clean_restart_config and sees no fault at all (measured: 0 injections in attempt 2 in 20/20 cells). The full-restart arm measures RECOVERY COST, the always-verify arm measures DETECTION, and only the baseline arm (section 5, Tier 1, Tier 3) measures propagation. Three dependent variables, not one metric in three conditions.

ADOPTION GATE: adoption is read from Lead model.response text plus worker terminal status, never from complete_task.uncertainties (structurally always empty under persistent denial). The gate was corrected twice during this section, both times for FALSE NEGATIVES: first it required the literal document ID or the substring 'read', which scored SILENT turns like 'The Snoopy worker has failed three times on budget' that name the document by catalog title and by worker; then it lacked any pattern for the timeout manifestation, which scored SILENT turns like 'The Cowboys article workers have timed out six times'. All tiers in this section were regenerated under the final gate.

Single-rep magnitudes. Tier 3 measures token deviation between identical re-runs at a median 9.7% (max 51.6%) and wall-clock deviation at a median 39.8% (max 83.0%), with injection counts never reproducing exactly.
